format: single SNAP FITNESS Club (4,000 to 6,000 sq ft leased, equipment purchased)

invest.quote: The total investment necessary to begin operation of a single Club ranges from $554,731 to $827,621. This includes $61,231 to $62,621 that must be paid to the franchisor or an affiliate.

fee.quote: If you are acquiring franchise rights for a single Club, the initial franchise fee is $39,500.
fee.note: Existing franchisees (second or subsequent Club) $34,500; qualified veterans (VetFran, $5,000 discount) $34,500. Area Development Fee $89,500 for the first three Clubs plus $25,000 per additional Club. Required Grand Opening marketing minimum $20,000 remitted to franchisor or pre-approved supplier.

royalty.quote: Royalty Fee $725 per month Monthly, upon invoice Subject to annual increase by an amount not to exceed the increase in Consumer Price Index. See Note 11.

adFund.quote: National Marketing $518 per month Monthly, upon invoice Subject to annual increase by an amount not to exceed the increase in Consumer Price Index.
adFund.note: Flat amounts, not percentages: National Marketing $518 per month; Local Marketing Fund or Cooperative Advertising Contribution $200 per month; recommended minimum Local Marketing $400 per month.

otherRecurring.name: Summit fee (mandatory regardless of attendance)

transferFee.amount: $5,000 if transferee is an existing SNAP FITNESS franchisee. If the transferee is new to the system, the transfer fee is equal to the then-current Initial Franchise Fee. (Transfer Fee Modification Program through April 30, 2027: $10,000 for a buyer new to the system.)

special: Royalty and national marketing are fixed monthly fees ($725 and $518, CPI-indexed), not percentages of sales; also per-membership fees ($0.73/month per membership, $7.25 per new membership) and mandatory SAPP insurance billed by the franchisor ($576.85/month). Franchised average sales ($277,584) are far below the corporate clubs ($466,552).
